font.reason: Vazirmatn is a variable-weight, well-covered Persian UI sans that preserves the source's restrained Swiss/product-interface tone and renders Persian joining and digits reliably at this small chip size.

components.name: ChipGridSingleSelectBlackout

rtlDecisions.what: The title OPTION GROUP became «گروه گزینه‌ها».
rtlDecisions.action: Translated idiomatically, removed uppercase and the 2.4px tracking, and used Vazirmatn with FA_LH.
rtlDecisions.why: Uppercase/tracking has no Persian equivalent and tracking would break joining; the neutral UI label keeps the original hierarchy.

rtlDecisions.what: The five option labels became «طرح گزینه یک»، «طرح گزینه دو»، «طرح گزینه سوم با نام بلند»، «طرح گزینه چهار»، and «طرح گزینه پنج ویژه».
rtlDecisions.action: Kept the original array/index order and rendered the chip rows under the inherited RTL direction.
rtlDecisions.why: Flex reading order mirrors so the first/selectable option occupies the right side, while the 3+2 centered geometry and locked positions stay intact. The long third label remains the width stress test.

rtlDecisions.what: The selected first chip's lift-to-center translation.
rtlDecisions.action: Kept the measured physical center calculation and the original vertical lift/scale timing; RTL row placement makes the selected chip start on the right and move inward.
rtlDecisions.why: The motion carries reading/layout direction, but the lift and scale are direction-neutral. Measuring once avoids reflow during the shrink.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept transform:none and the original opacity curve; only the visual row order is mirrored by direction:rtl.
rtlDecisions.why: The source intent explicitly requires position lock so dimming reads as single selection rather than a page re-layout.

rtlDecisions.action: Used Persian digits, percent sign, decimal separator and left-pointing arrow; retained the original double-space token skeleton and per-word darkening beats. The old value remains on the right of the arrow and the new value on its left.
rtlDecisions.why: Numeric glyph order is kept intact, while the price-flow arrow follows RTL reading direction. The effect is per word, so no Persian letters are split into unsafe animated spans.

rtlDecisions.what: Grey press flash, black confirmation, bounce, easing, seeds and all frame timings.
rtlDecisions.action: Preserved the upstream formulas and constants exactly.
rtlDecisions.why: These are physical/UI state transitions rather than text-direction semantics; changing them would lose the one-frame press and three/five-frame confirmation beats.

components.timingNotes: Persian copy is longer in the long chip and uses 1.1x sizing, but all chip widths are content-driven inside the same centered rows, and the original d/FS/lift/caption intervals remain unchanged.

rasterHandling.action: None required; the composition is entirely vector/CSS text and shapes with no raster asset or baked-in foreign text.

verification.comparison: Viewed Persian and matching original PNGs for entrance, press flash, selected state, lift-to-center, caption reveal and final hold.
